competitor.basis: In competitor_pool (passed mobile checks); page title 'Home Remodeling Company Shrewsbury, MA | Mid-State Kitchens', 479 Hartford Turnpike, Shrewsbury, about 5 miles from CORE's 41 Boylston St, Worcester address; offers 'Kitchen Remodeling Design & Installation'.

assessment: Opinion: an established, active Worcester design-build remodeller with a weekly-ish blog and named owner; strong fit on activity and ticket size, though the service mix is broad (ADUs, additions, kitchens, baths).
inference_rejected: Niche passed on the about page wording and the homepage OUR SERVICES block (kitchens, additions, bathrooms); the homepage headline also says 'Specializing in high-value ADUs, Kitchens, Additions, and Whole-Home Transformations', so kitchens and baths are among several primary lines rather than the only one.

Team page names only 'Corey, Owner and President'; the full name Corey Plourde comes from the about page and the homepage ('owner Corey Plourde was recently featured on remodeling industry podcasts'), both on their own site.

name: Boca Walk-In Tubs & Showers

niche_evidence.quote: Boca Walk-In Tubs has designed and manufactured therapeutic walk-in tubs at our factory in Woodstock, GA

g4_notes: Not run: stopped at NICHE. The business is a walk-in tub manufacturer that sells factory-direct and installs its own product ('Nationwide shipping available from our Woodstock facility'); no kitchen work and no general bathroom remodelling service advertised.
assessment: Opinion: a single-product walk-in tub manufacturer with in-house installers, closer to a product maker than a kitchen and bath remodelling contractor; the coordinator may override if accessibility-bath installers are in scope.
inference_rejected: Earlier waves passed New Bath Today (walk-in tubs and shower panels) on niche; Boca was rejected here because its own about page leads with manufacturing ('We design, manufacture, and install every tub ourselves') and national shipping, and it advertises no kitchen or full bathroom remodels. Flagged for coordinator review.
About page names founders only as 'Bob and Carol' (first names); not usable as a decision maker in any case.
